description: React component AdminPage that provides admin functionalities like triggering ingestion processes, displaying ingestion run history, and catalog lists of roles and competencies. It interacts with an API via apiClient to retrieve and manipulate data related to admin tasks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch roles, competencies, and ingestion runs, updating component state accordingly.

methods.name: triggerIngestion
methods.description: Triggers an ingestion process via API and reloads the data.
